title: Deal with Distraction from Within
coreMove: Catch the urge in the body, label it plainly, and create a small pause before it chooses the next action.
sourcePressure: The chapter stays with internal triggers and moves from diagnosis toward intercepting urges before they become visible distraction.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would tell the reader to resist urges harder instead of watching the urge long enough to separate it from action.

hook: Deal with Distraction from Within as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: court interpreter waiting outside a tense hearing
exampleSpecs.audience: interpreter who opens a game whenever nerves rise
exampleSpecs.stakes: one missed announcement can disrupt the docket
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she names the tight jaw and fluttering chest before unlocking the phone
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A courthouse badge lies beside a folded hearing schedule.

exampleSpecs.domain: customs broker reviewing a flagged shipment
exampleSpecs.audience: broker who checks sports scores when uncertainty spikes
exampleSpecs.stakes: a client shipment sits in limbo while the broker escapes ambiguity
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he writes 'uncertainty in stomach' on the clearance worksheet before opening the tariff table
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A clearance worksheet is clipped to a yellow customs notice.

exampleSpecs.domain: choir director before a difficult rehearsal correction
exampleSpecs.audience: director tempted to browse sheet-music forums instead of addressing a sour entrance
exampleSpecs.stakes: the ensemble repeats the same flaw because discomfort wins
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she feels heat in her neck, names it, and asks altos to start at bar seventeen
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A conductor score is open to a penciled bar seventeen.

exampleSpecs.audience: keeper who wanders into supply shopping when numbers look wrong
exampleSpecs.stakes: a tank problem gets slower treatment if the urge is obeyed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he logs the urge to flee after the nitrate spike and retests before browsing supplies
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A nitrate test vial stands beside a damp logbook.

exampleSpecs.domain: wedding officiant drafting a ceremony after a family dispute
exampleSpecs.audience: officiant who reaches for recipes when the couple's conflict feels delicate
exampleSpecs.stakes: ceremony language stays evasive unless the discomfort is named
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she labels the urge as conflict dread and writes one honest sentence before checking anything else
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A fountain pen rests on a half-written ceremony page.

exampleSpecs.domain: rail-signal maintainer filling an incident report
exampleSpecs.audience: maintainer tempted to open a video app after a near miss
exampleSpecs.stakes: the report loses precision when adrenaline becomes escape
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, his thumb hovers over video; after, he writes 'adrenaline buzzing' and completes the signal sequence
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A signal diagram sits under a grease-stained incident form.

skillTargets: identify when a scenario calls for: Catch the urge in the body, label it plainly, and create a small pause before it chooses the next action.
choose the action that stays inside Deal with Distraction from Within's source pressure rather than adjacent productivity advice
explain why the tempting weak version fails: A weak run would tell the reader to resist urges harder instead of watching the urge long enough to separate it from action.
use chapter-specific terms such as urge, internal trigger, pause, labeling in transfer scenarios

tryThisNowSpec: At the next urge, write the body signal in six words or fewer, wait one breath, then choose the planned next action.
